**Step 1, Scene:** A breakfast tray with toast, a ham English muffin, a banana, a blueberry muffin, butter and marmalade portions, and a mug of tea with milk.

**Step 2, Vessel:** The main paper plate (bread) is about 20 cm across, so its area is about 314 cm². The second paper plate (ham muffin) is about 18 cm. Food is spread across the tray, so the coverage estimates below are approximate.

**Step 3, Items:** Sourdough toast, English muffin with ham, banana, blueberry muffin, butter portion, marmalade portion, tea with milk.

**Step 4, Area:** Toast about 30% (≈94 cm²), muffin and ham about 10% (≈30 cm²), banana about 12% (≈38 cm²), blueberry muffin about 10% (≈30 cm²), butter and marmalade about 3% combined. Food covers roughly 65% of the plate area.

**Step 5, Volume:** Toast 94 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 140 ml. Muffin and ham 30 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 90 ml. Banana ≈ 120 ml. Blueberry muffin ≈ 75 ml. Butter and marmalade ≈ 10 ml combined.

**Step 6, Grams:** Toast 140 ml × 0.6 ≈ 80 g (slices are denser than a loaf, so I used a value between the bread-slice and loaf densities). Muffin and ham ≈ 55 g, split as 40 g muffin and 15 g ham. Banana ≈ 120 g (whole fruit). Blueberry muffin ≈ 60 g. Butter 7 g and marmalade 14 g. Tea with milk ≈ 180 g.

**Step 7, Energy:** Toast 80 g at 260 kcal/100 g ≈ 208 kcal. English muffin 40 g at 220 kcal/100 g ≈ 88 kcal. Ham 15 g at 110 kcal/100 g ≈ 17 kcal. Banana 120 g at 89 kcal/100 g ≈ 107 kcal. Blueberry muffin 60 g at 380 kcal/100 g ≈ 228 kcal. Butter 7 g at 717 kcal/100 g ≈ 50 kcal. Marmalade 14 g at 250 kcal/100 g ≈ 35 kcal. Tea with milk 180 g at 12 kcal/100 g ≈ 22 kcal.

**Step 8, Sanity check:** Total ≈ 516 g and ≈ 755 kcal. That is plausible for a full breakfast tray with two baked items, a banana and a muffin.
